justification: The ghost preserves all material semantic claims of the original: (1) closure target is residual-recursion, not zero distortion; (2) the gate flips from fidelity to does-residual-recurse; (3) structured partials that seed the next grade are the target band; (4) unstructured noise is the real loss; (5) a recursable residual cannot be faked, making it harder to game than fidelity. The ghost reorganizes the delivery (ORIGINAL: thesis-then-gate-then-contrast; GHOST: inversion-then-question-then-answer-then-contrast), but this is rhetorical structure, not semantic loss. The core relation between graded reconstruction, residual recursion, and the gameability differential is intact. No claims are inverted, dropped, or invented.
